propositions: A standing, incremental per-criterion effectiveness recorder reads REVIEW_RESULT sidecars and appends firing rows to an append-only ledger, auto-including all criterion ids without per-criterion registration.

The recorder computes detection_proxy (blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (blocking fix-units later dropped/de-escalated) metrics per criterion from sidecar history alone, without outcome-corpus git-walk or LLM cost.
The recorder is idempotent via dedup key (ticket, review_ts, round_uuid, norm_id) and prune-immune because the ledger captures firings before the sidecar's 50-round retention prune.

The --report mode computes per-criterion metrics over a configurable trailing window (N most-recent tickets by review_ts), outputs criterion_effectiveness.json with null denominators when sample counts are zero, and never auto-records.

The implementation is deterministic instrumentation only (no LLM calls, no eval spend) and complements R7's outcome-corpus metric by providing a within-review FP signal distinct from post-hoc force-close/reopen detection.
